hero.subheadline: While we generate our own power, our integration with the national grid provides a critical third layer of energy security.

sections.title: The Triple-Layer Power Strategy
sections.body: Uptime in the AI world is non-negotiable. To ensure 99.9% availability, Kenya AI Compute utilizes a 'Triple-Layer' power strategy. Layer 1 is our primary captive hybrid power plant, providing 1MW+ of direct power at $0.04/kWh. Layer 2 is our industrial UPS and high-density battery arrays, capable of supporting the full IT load during generation transitions. Layer 3 is our strategic connection to the Kenyan national grid (Kenya Power). This connection acts as a giant 'safety net' and secondary N+1 source. In the event of primary generation maintenance, the facility can seamlessly switch to the grid, ensuring that client GPUs never lose power. This integration also allows us to explore future grid-export opportunities, contributing to Kenya's energy stability while diversifying our project's revenue streams. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
